title: Muraja'ah: An-Nazi'at 1 to 16 with muttasil and munfasil: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 24. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا (١) وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا (٢) وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا (٣) فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا (٤) فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا (٥) يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ (٦) تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ (٧) قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ (٨) أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ (٩) يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ (١٠)

keywords.def: madd letter ends a word, hamza starts the next: 4 or 5 counts

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of 79:1-16 in register order.
questions.a: 79:1-16 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:1-16 and one older surah to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the weakest ayat, then log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your own target from today's feedback in the portal response box. Start: 'Next time I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'Next time I will hold the madd lazim in ٱلطَّآمَّةُ for six counts.'

questions.q: Think again: Which is harder to keep consistent: muttasil or munfasil? Why does consistency matter?
questions.a: Answers vary; choosing one length (4 or 5) and keeping it for both through the whole recitation is the key.
